title: How to connect Google Sheets to ChatGPT
summary: Here's how to send prompts to ChatGPT from your Google Sheet and add the response to the same row—automatically.
body_markdown: You can also use[Zapier's dedicated ChatGPT Google Sheets integration](https://zapier.com/apps/google-sheets/integrations/chatgpt) to add a ChatGPT step to your workflow (using your own OpenAI account). But we recommend using AI by Zapier instead: it offers more powerful features with prompt testing, knowledge sources, and agentic tool calling. Plus, it allows you to skip the token cost and offers more flexibility since you can easily switch to another AI model without rebuilding your workflow.
